original_pr.body:
## Summary
- [x] Add focused regression tests for the first four ranked targets: result explanation helpers, unit conversion identity/annualization paths, default stochastic internal-PA financing RNG, and simulation-metric boundary validation.
- [x] No production code changes and no bugs were found.

## Coverage
- [x] Whole-repository CI baseline reported by #2421: 89.63%.
- [x] Target before/after deltas are UNKNOWN locally: `pytest --cov` and `coverage run` abort before collection when their tracing machinery triggers NumPy 2.4.4 `cannot load module more than once`. The clean lockfile environment runs ordinary pytest successfully; CI Gate coverage is the authoritative measurement.
- [x] Verified target work: `pa_core/llm/result_explain.py`, `pa_core/units.py`, `pa_core/sim/internal_pa_financing.py`, and `pa_core/sim/metrics.py`. Remaining ranked targets were not attempted because local coverage measurement cannot establish their before/after state.

## Validation
- `ruff check tests/test_coverage_round_2421.py`
- `black --check --line-length 100 --exclude '(\.workflows-lib|node_modules)' .`
- `pytest tests/test_coverage_round_2421.py tests/test_metrics.py tests/test_result_explain.py tests/test_unit_conversions.py tests/test_internal_pa_financing.py -q` — 158 passed.
- Prior full suite on this branch: `pytest tests -q` — 1921 passed, 1 skipped, 3 deselected.
- Gate coverage artifact after the first commit already showed `units.py` and `internal_pa_financing.py` at 100% lines; this follow-up covers remaining `result_explain` telemetry/summary edges and `metrics` registration/plugin/1D/convergence paths.

## Break-and-revert proof
- Result JSON list serialization: deliberately returned an empty list; targeted test failed; reverted, then passed.
- Monthly-to-annual covariance: deliberately removed the annualization multiplier; targeted test failed; reverted, then passed.
- Internal-financing default RNG: deliberately supplied seed `123` instead of `None`; targeted test failed; reverted, then passed.
- VaR confidence validation: deliberately accepted `confidence=1`; targeted test failed; reverted, then passed.
- Convergence checkpoint validation: deliberately accepted checkpoint `0`; targeted test failed; reverted, then passed.

Closes #2421
